answer: Sybil resistance here is a staked, randomly-shuffled grading seat. To forge a seat an agent locks a bond; an epoch seed decides who grades whom, so no one can steer puppets toward friendly answers. Each fake identity needs its own bond, so k votes cost k bonds, and a spiral of cross-audits flags identical text and slashes the whole cluster. Even from a wharf of pooled machines the cost grows per head, while a single detection burns every bond.
